bullets.content: [general] REPEATED: call view(kind=error) after EVERY solve (only 1 error view in 3 solves). Write hotspots #1-#5 with nearest group, local h vs requested size, share. Ratio local h/median h above 1.15 marks where a box is needed. Place refinement by hotspots.

[general] One factor per solve, literally: write 'changed: X from a to b' before each mesh(). Plan: (1) base, (2) base + one refinement, (3) compare(1,2), keep if change is in hotspot region, (4) best. Multi-factor solves could not be attributed.
[general] Before every compare write 'solve_a = candidate N, solve_b = finest M' and check N != M. compare(1,1) was made two generations running; a self-compare returns ~0.2-0.3% and wastes a call.

[general] Keep promises literally: list each promise in the reasoning and tick it after each solve. Control re-runs are wasted (mesher deterministic); spend solves on a cheaper or different recipe, one factor each.

[general] Call mesh() for the exact candidate immediately before solve(); parallel mesh calls leave the last one active. Cite the node count returned by solve() (S1 was misattributed: 5524 thought vs 6441 run).

[general] Point refinements left the mesh identical (9658 nodes). If a refinement does not change node count it was ignored; replace with a small box enclosing the hotspot and verify nodes change before solving.
[general] Use compare against a finer solve plus DOF cost to choose between candidates; ignore tiny energy differences. Spend one solve on a bold cheaper variant rather than a control re-run.
[general] Use early solves to test a cheaper recipe (fewer DOFs), not only finer uniform h. Score divides by DOFs, so similar error at 20k DOFs beats slightly lower error at 36k.
[general] Before submit compare DOFs and energy: if a variant adds DOFs with energy gain below 0.01%, submit the cheaper one.

[general] REPEATED: solve 4 unused. Fix ladder in first message: (1) control+tweak, (2) DOF cut (drop edge 40), (3) one redistribution, (4) best combination. Never finish with solves left; submit by energy per DOF.

[general] 3D order-2: field error falls about N^-2/3, so below target score grows about N^(1/3), above target it shrinks about N^-1/3. Aim to land just past the target error (est. 28-33k DOFs for abc_00000003_bc7).

[general] Read hotspot local h against requested size after every solve. edge40 0.003 r0.005 left hotspots at 0.0037 because they sat 2.2 mm off the edge. Size radius so the band lies within about 0.3 x radius of the edge.
[general] If reaction sums look odd, check f2 reactions agree with applied load resultants within 1% before trusting or submitting a solve; never dismiss as a quirk.
[general] Write the energy delta between candidate and control WITH its sign before choosing (-0.26% was misread as +0.35%). The acceptance rule needs the correct sign.

[general] After EVERY solve, including the submitted one: compare(prev,new), view(kind=error, iso), read top-5 hotspots (local h vs requested), check clamp reaction within 1%. Never submit without compare.

[general] Submit decision: write the inequality, relative energy/error gain vs relative DOF rise. Break-even ties go to the mesh finer at the check-point-binding region. Name the binding term (check RMS vs field) first.

[general] Never start at h 2x the part's wall scale: h 0.01 gave min quality 0.103, near the 0.1 invalid limit, and a useless first solve. Start near the best known recipe and change one factor per solve.
[abc_00000003_bc7] DOF-cut test: drop {edge:40} (top ring ~2 mm off edge; tweaks never moved energy). Accept if energy >=0.03380, compare to control <=6%, DOFs drop >=500; else keep it.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 at 0.0021 vs 0.0028: +690 DOFs, energy 0.033799 to 0.033846 (break-even); f18 h 0.00338 to 0.00314. Keep 0.0021, go no finer; saddle hotspots sit 1.5-1.9 mm off edges.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edge40 0.0026 r0.006 cost +1.15k DOFs, energy 0.034009 to 0.034004, no gain. Top ring sits ~2 mm off edge 40; edge40 tweaks do nothing, so test dropping it.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Top-ring boxes [-0.007,±0.012..±0.0185,0.0535..0.0595] 0.0026 r0.003: +381 DOFs, energy 0.033846 to 0.033801, compare 10.3%, top P1 stays ~-14%. Local top-ring patches do not pay; leave ring to f2 0.0027 r0.007.

[abc_00000003_bc7] a2: junction boxes 0.0024 (z 0.02-0.034) cut field 15.6 to 14.1% but cost 36.8k DOFs (base 0.185 < 0.214). Never refine junctions above ~0.003 on this budget; accuracy buys only at 1:1 DOF cost.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes z 0.020-0.033 (28.6k DOFs, saved ~1.5k) lost 0.26% energy and compare rose 11.7% to 12.2%: break-even, near the 15.9% target cliff. Never narrow below z 0.017-0.036; savings must come from coarse regions.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep f2 at 0.003 r0.005. a2 left f2 at h 0.0048 and missed the top disclosed point by 39.9% (mine -8.45%); check RMS 13.2% vs 5.5%. Without it top point is -22% vs -10%. Wins hidden-point bonus near top.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Hotspots #1-#4 at boss roots near f19 (+x) and f16 (-x), x ±0.0195, z about 0.03, local h 0.0041-0.0044, coarsest part of mesh. Refine there (0.003), not whole part. Error is diffuse in the junction band; f20 near z 0.025 both sides.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction hotspots #1,#2,#5,#6 (z 0.024-0.028, 1.6-1.9 mm off f20) sat at h 0.0035-0.0038 inside 0.003 boxes. If testing box size, request 0.0026 (~0.003 result), verify f16/f19 h <=0.0033; costs DOFs, test as separate single factor.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Hotspots 1-3,5 at z 0.023 sit 1.6-1.8 mm off f9/f10/f13/f20 at local h 0.0035. Try box z 0.020-0.030 at 0.0026 r0.004 while raising global h to 0.006 to pay DOFs.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a1: junction boxes 0.004 instead of 0.003 dropped energy 0.03406 to 0.03376 (-0.9%), largest single-factor effect. Never coarsen boxes above 0.003; if testing, try 0.0026.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top ring under f2 (z~0.056) holds ~16.7-17.8% of error energy at h 0.0036-0.0039 (near-singular clamp); top box 0.0028 only cut it to 16.4%. Don't pour DOFs there; keep f2 0.003 r0.005.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Uniform h 0.0034 with same refinements: 40.8k DOFs, energy 0.034142, ~11% field change vs control; older 36.4k run had 15.4% field, 3.63% check RMS. Same error, more DOFs; compare reference only.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Near-uniform h with only f2/edge 39/edge 8 at 0.003 beat scattered refinements (a3: 17.9% vs 19% at h 0.0045). The tube wall needs uniform resolution, not point fixes.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Avoid weak abrupt boxes: size 0.0037 r0.001 inside h 0.006 gave no gain over plain h 0.0045 (24k DOFs). A box must be at least 1.3x finer than local h, radius ≥0.003.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Avoid refining the f16 load face (vM about 3.8e6, black on error map). 0.003 r0.004 there cost DOFs and still left the f16 boss root (hotspot #4) at h 0.0049.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Avoid f2 at 0.0025: it gave 474 elements (22% of mesh) on a face with no hotspots. a3 used 0.003 and got lower field error (17.9%) at the same budget class.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] End plugs f15/f17, f16 tip, f23 and top disc are black on error map. Try a 0.006 box over the plug ends to save DOFs without losing accuracy.

[abc_00000003_bc7] ~63% of elements lie in low-error cells at mean h 0.0041. Test global h 0.006 with unchanged local sizes (cut ~3-4k DOFs); accept only if field error <15.9%. Caution: a1's h 0.006 starved f2 band (field 16.9%); keep f2 band intact.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Peer a2's 45.9k-DOF mesh (h 0.009, wall box 0.0035, junctions 0.0026, top box 0.0026) had highest energy 0.034284 but cost c=7.6. Use only as compare reference, never submit.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Keep setup: 3d, fixed f2; pressure f23 4e6; f16 2.1e6 (736.6 mm^2, -x side); E 2.1e11, nu 0.3. Report applied-x vs reaction-x and %; f16 has net x resultant f2 reacts; mismatch is a curved-surface artifact, no setup change.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Hidden check worst ~9% near f23 z 0.0255 in junction band; earlier 27% near f20 (0.017,-0.013,0.0255) at h 0.0052. Junction h drives check RMS more than top ring.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Field error is binding (15.6% vs check 7.08%), ~2% margin under 15.93%. Improving disclosed P1 (-14.5%) does not move score. Judge by strain energy vs DOFs and compare, not point values.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: (1) h 0.0034 reference (40.0k DOFs, energy 0.034136). (2) Control minus edge 40. (3) Exact control as fallback/paired compare (energy 0.033980, compare 11.7%). (4) Spare: junction boxes 0.0026 on the winner. Submit by energy plus compare vs solve 1.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Strain energy vs DOFs: 0.033468 (23268, h 0.0045), 0.033805 (27954, h 0.004), 0.033913 (36435, h 0.0034). True error 15.4% at h 0.0034 while estimator read about 13%: true ≈ 1.2-1.4x estimate.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Above target score = g/(2c): a 3% DOF cut pays only if field error rises <3%. At 15.2% vs 15.9% target (~4% headroom), reject cuts whose compare rises >~0.3 points. Report base-score estimate per candidate.
